flows.flow_name: Business First Plus - Local Mobile Plans

automation_boundary.automated_scope: SMB Portal Homepage -> Products Menu -> Mobile -> Value Plans (Business First Plus) -> Select Local Tab -> Choose Local Plan (110 / 150 / 200) -> Click 'Buy Now' -> Verify B2B Ordering Email Verification Page
automation_boundary.external_boundary: Corporate Trade License verification and Live SMS/Email OTP authentication are external boundaries.

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to e& UAE SMB Portal Homepage
canonical_steps.expected_result: SMB portal loads successfully with active business navigation header

canonical_steps.action: Dismiss cookie banner if present
canonical_steps.expected_result: Cookie overlay is dismissed cleanly

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to Products -> Mobile -> Business First Plus Plans
canonical_steps.expected_result: Business First Plus plans page loads displaying plan cards and tabs

canonical_steps.action: Switch to 'Local' plans tab
canonical_steps.expected_result: Local tab is activated displaying Local 110, Local 150, and Local 200 plans

canonical_steps.action: Select {{plan_name}} and review plan allowances & promo pricing
canonical_steps.expected_result: Plan details show discounted rate, local data, local minutes, CUG minutes, and flexi SMS

canonical_steps.action: Click 'Buy Now' on {{plan_name}}
canonical_steps.expected_result: User is redirected to B2B Ordering verification page

canonical_steps.action: Verify B2B Ordering Email Verification Page
canonical_steps.expected_result: Online ordering email verification screen is displayed with matching plan parameters
